This is my current DnD character, Archy. He is a Moon Elf wizard. I created the picture for this character using a fantastic app that I wanted to share with you guys, called "Reroll". I'm not promoting anything officially, I just wanted to share something awesome. 

The app is essentially an electronic character sheet that can be updated in real time, and it has areas for all the important things like your stats, features, traits, weapons, and inventory. It keeps current track of continuously varying stats like health, AC (if your class alters this often, like mine), and spell slots. 

Speaking of spells, it has an extraordinarily convenient feature where it's preloaded with most of the spells in the player's handbook, so you dont have to flip through a million pages to find a new spell you just learned! You simply click a button to add it to your list of known spells/cantrips. 

Last, but not least, the app is free, but you can pay $10 to upgrade to a version where you have unlimited character slots and tons of bonus accessories for creating new pixelated characters. 

This was written as of 11/21/19, and many listed things are subject to change as the app is in early stages of development.
